mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room addition project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a room addition project varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and local permitting processes. A small, straightforward addition might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while larger or more complex projects could extend to 6-12 months or more. Permitting in cities like Berkeley or Oakland, for instance, can add several weeks or even months to the initial timeline, a practical tradeoff for ensuring compliance and safety.
